title: Earth orientation cartographic reference layers
processing: Select source features, retain polygon topology and round coordinates to six decimal places; project onto a sphere at runtime. No hand-drawn boundary added.

china.meaning: Generalized administrative reference geometry at 1:110 million scale. Source cartographic representation, not a standard approved map or surveyed boundary.

tibet.meaning: Generalized administrative region reference at 1:50 million scale. This is distinct from the natural plateau geography.

plateau.meaning: Physical labeling area, roughly accurate to 1:50 million despite the dataset theme at 1:10 million. Not a strict research delineation, digital elevation model, administrative border or calculation boundary.

flows: Authored conceptual southern moisture and western circulation relationships. Coordinates indicate direction and geographical relation only, not observed trajectories, uniform prevailing winds or forecasts.
